summary: Youlife Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency letter for non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company has 180 calendar days, until January 25, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. No immediate delisting or trading impact occurs. The filing does not involve a special situation such as acquisition, restructuring, or capital return; it is a routine listing standards notification. The company states it is considering options to cure the deficiency.
